scope: Standalone synthetic allocation and cache-trace checks, not Minecraft generation, not an FPS benchmark
allocation_unit: bytes allocated on the measuring thread per fresh cache, includes intermediate growth arrays
old: HashMap<Long,Float>, deterministic mixed 64-bit keys, finite heights
new: ColumnFloatCache(1024), initial 32 slots, grow when half full
limitations: Not measured on the user's modpack or PC
Does not measure FPS or real chunk-generation latency
